title: Data Dictionary for nyc_capital_projects.csv
description: NYC Capital Projects Database (CPDB), sourced from NYC Open Data resource fi59-268w. One row per capital project, with the three budget aggregates the Capital Commitment Plan and the City budget track separately.

maprojid.title: Project ID
maprojid.description: Managing-agency project identifier; unique per project.

magencyacro.title: Managing Agency
magencyacro.description: Acronym of the agency managing the project.

magencyname.title: Managing Agency Name
magencyname.description: Full name of the managing agency.

totalplannedcommit.title: Planned
totalplannedcommit.description: Total planned commitments for the project allocated in the Capital Commitment Plan.

commit_total.title: Committed
commit_total.description: Total committed funding associated with the project within the City's budget.

spent_total.title: Spent
spent_total.description: Total funding spent associated with the project within the City's budget.
